protocol.control_notes: P4 data, mask generator seed, model RNG seed and evaluation scope are shared experiment controls. Validation checkpoint selection is added where the author release has none. No test draw affects selection.

shared_forecast_stage.source: existing P4 PatchTST interface, same structure as E23; task extension for imputation methods

T1.version: official T1_Exchange.sh and run.py defaults; shared block masks/task interface
T1.notes: Official type3 means constant LR. Mask embedding false is the released script/default, despite the paper's mask-aware description. Stage 2 uses the common P4 forecast interface. Exchange-Rate official script matches these parameters; input dimensions8.

SAITS.version: SAITS-base (not an ETTh1-specific optimum); pinned core 660b87f19c1277065f314f24134f646229e89ca9
SAITS.notes: No unique ETTh1 paper configuration found: use publicly specified SAITS-base, not the Electricity best model. Epoch-level fixed P4 validation replaces the original step validation frequency; no extra test-derived tuning. Global train standardization feeds the imputer. Exchange-Rate uses documented SAITS-base; no dataset-specific optimum claimed.

BRITS.notes: No ETTh1-specific configuration: README example supplies hidden size, weight and batch omitted from default parser. Necessary adaptations are 48->96, 35->7, device-safe tensors, unused legacy import removal, and classification label_weight=0 because P4 has no labels. Preserve original summed ORT and consistency weights; do not use the SAITS-repository BRITS normalization. Validation checkpoint selection and shared forecast head are P4 extensions. Acceleration must pass eager vs compiled equivalence before launch.
